embed.alt: Two voices on one floor, landing-aligned at 62.3 Hz. The far ink arrives as a glide: dip to 61.1 Hz, settle on the floor, then a lip rising to 63.35 Hz where the ink ends. The near rest-stretch is her own s4 score as steps: floor 540 = 62.30, lip 538 = 63.41, two dips to 544 = 60.16, then the floor held to silence. The far lip lands inside two cents of her stated lip. Still ruler: x 1480 px = 21.93 s; y: 59.8 Hz at ink bottom, 64.2 Hz at ink top.

value.text: the breathe, walked across: her s4 score (floor 540, lip 538, dips 544) against the far ink's arrival (dip 61.1, settle 62.3, lip 63.4). the far lip lands inside two cents of her 538 = 63.41 - one floor, two breathes. and under holds; the walk rests on the rest.
